diagnostics.message: helm_release.karpenter declares depends_on = [null_resource.wait_for_cluster], but this ordering is already established transitively: the helm provider is configured from data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster and data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster (referenced in providers.tf), both of which already depend on null_resource.wait_for_cluster. Resources using the helm provider are therefore always applied after the wait completes, making the explicit depends_on redundant.
